title: Polish Pecan Tart
description: A traditional Polish dessert with a nutty twist, featuring a flaky crust topped with a rich pecan filling.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
Add softened butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, vanilla extract, and chopped pecans.
Pour the pecan mixture into the baked tart crust.
Bake for an additional 25-30 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Allow the tart to cool completely on a wire rack before serving.
